title: Affine tensor chart ring coordinates
statement: Let f:X → S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U and V affine opens with U ⊆ f⁻¹V. Set A=Γ(X,U), R=Γ(S,V) using f, B=A⊗[R]A, W=p₁⁻¹U∩p₂⁻¹U and J=ker μ. There exists a ring equivalence r:B≃Γ(X×_S X,W), sending 1⊗a to p₂*(a) and a⊗1 to p₁*(a). Every j∈J lifts to a section of the actual module-sheaf kernel of O→Δ_*O whose inclusion is r(j). The fibre product and kernel conormal are those of [def-pc-fibre-product] and [def-sc-diagonal-conormal].

source.place: Tag 08S2 (lemma-differentials-diagonal), affine chart calculation; Tag 01R3 (lemma-affine-conormal); Tag 01KJ (schemes, lemma-diagonal-immersion); read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: Let H be the defining self-pullback square for f. Apply Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen to H, V, U, U and W = p1^-1(U) intersect p2^-1(U). No flatness is required. By isIso_pushoutSection_iff, the two projection appLE maps make the section ring on W a pushout of the two copies of f.appLE(V,U).

The same pushout is computed by the tensor-product cocone, using CommRingCat.pushoutCoconeIsColimit with the prescribed algebra structure. IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso gives a categorical ring isomorphism; commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv gives r. Evaluate comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom at WalkingSpan.right and WalkingSpan.left to obtain respectively r(1 tensor a) = p2*(a) and r(a tensor 1) = p1*(a). The argument also works for empty affine opens and zero rings.

Set delta = pullback.diagonal f. appLE_comp_appLE and delta followed by either projection being the identity show that delta.app(W) composed with the two projection appLE maps is the same ring morphism. Thus delta.app(W)(r(1 tensor a - a tensor 1)) = 0. KaehlerDifferential.span_range_eq_ideal identifies J with the ideal generated by these differences. Ideal.span_le then proves J is contained in the kernel of the composite ring homomorphism delta.app(W) composed with r.

For j in J, the preceding containment says delta.app(W)(r(j)) = 0. By the definition of SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit, this is exactly vanishing under evaluation of the sheaf morphism O -> delta_* O. Apply the proved upstream Scheme.Modules.range_map_kernelι to obtain a section s of its actual categorical sheaf kernel on W whose inclusion is r(j). This uses sectionwise preservation of kernels and does not require identifying an ideal sheaf or choosing a witness from any unproved existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Affine tensor-chart calculation in the proof of Lemma 29.33.7; Tag 01KJ for the affine diagonal neighbourhood. Implemented directly using the Mathlib affine-open section pushout, tensor-product colimit uniqueness, the generator description of the multiplication ideal, and the proved upstream sectionwise kernel lemma.

theorem diagonalConormal_affine_ideal_class_core (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV).hom.toAlgebra
    let W := (pullback.fst f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ⊓ (pullback.snd f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
    ∃ r : (Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(S, V.1)] Γ(X, U.1)) ≃+* Γ(pullback f f, W),
      (∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), r ((1 : Γ(X, U.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V.1)] a) =
        (pullback.snd f f).appLE U.1 W inf_le_right a) ∧
      (∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), r (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V.1)] (1 : Γ(X, U.1))) =
        (pullback.fst f f).appLE U.1 W inf_le_left a) ∧
      ∀ j : KaehlerDifferential.ideal Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1),
        ∃ s : Γ(kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom), W),
          (kernel.ι (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app (op W) s = r j
